inputs.title: Cassiopeia A (MIRI Image)
inputs.credit: NASA, ESA, CSA, D. Milisavljevic (Purdue University), T. Temim (Princeton University), I. De Looze (UGent), J. DePasquale (STScI)
inputs.acquisition: The publisher's JPEG (4008 x 4009 px), downloaded unchanged; not tracked. Its scale and direction on the sky are the file's embedded tags; its place is the tags' own (recipe observation). A display composite, not a calibrated scientific array.
inputs.license: CC-BY-4.0; retain the complete recorded credit.

inputs.title: The [Ar II] ejecta of Cassiopeia A, 10632 cells of the model of DeLaney et al. (2010) as places and speeds
inputs.acquisition: Built from the Chandra X-ray Center's zip of the model's ASCII VTK files by the generator, which downloads the zip, reads newar-ascii.vtk and writes each cell of one model unit as a row. Restored from the source cache; not tracked.
inputs.license: NASA material, free to use with the credit NASA/CXC/SAO.
